title: Average Body Temperature Fell Below 98.6°F
hook: 98.6°F is not the average body temperature anymore.
closing: Your personal baseline can be cooler than the number everyone memorized.
question: What is your resting temperature?

segments.say: Men born in the 1990s averaged 97.5°F. Modern bodies run cooler than the old textbook number.
Men's average body temperature fell 1.06°F. The shift was larger than the decline measured in women.
The original thermometer readings recalculate to 98.2°F. Even the historic benchmark was warmer than the corrected average.
